question: Which of the following plants does not reproduce by vegetative propagation?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mango**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• **Vegetative propagation:**

 
 
• This is a type of asexual reproduction where new plants grow from the vegetative parts (like stem, root, leaf) of a plant.
 
 
 
• **Mango, grape, sugarcane, and rose:**
 
 
• **​** All these plants can reproduce through vegetative propagation.
 
• For example, mango can be propagated by grafting, grape by cuttings, sugarcane by stem cuttings, and rose by cuttings.
 
 
 
• **Mango:**
 
 
• **​** Mango is primarily grown from seeds. Although mango trees can be propagated by grafting, it's not a widely used method.
 
 
 
• 
 
**Therefore, out of the given options, mango is the plant that does not primarily reproduce through vegetative propagation.**

 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Grape:** Grapes can be easily propagated by cutting a vine and planting it.
 
• **Sugarcane:** Sugarcane stem cuttings can be planted to grow new plants.
 
• **Rose:** Rose cuttings can be planted in soil to produce new plants.
